description: Source code for the EditLogFilterDialog class, a GUI dialog for editing log filters in Android Logcat within IntelliJ IDEA/JetBrains IDEs.

classes.name: EditLogFilterDialog
classes.description: A dialog window for creating, editing, and managing log filters in Android Logcat within IntelliJ IDEA.

methods.name: createEditorFields
methods.description: Initializes GUI components for editing log filter properties.

methods.name: initFiltersList
methods.description: Sets up the list component displaying existing filters.

methods.name: initFiltersToolbar
methods.description: Creates toolbar actions for adding and removing filters.

methods.name: parseExistingMessagesIfNecessary
methods.description: Parses existing log messages to populate tag, PID, and package name suggestions.

methods.name: resetFieldEditors
methods.description: Updates GUI fields based on the selected filter entry.

methods.name: createNewFilterEntry
methods.description: Creates a new filter entry with a unique name.

methods.name: getUniqueName
methods.description: Generates a unique filter name not already used.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates user input before saving filter settings.

methods.name: getCustomLogFiltersEntry
methods.description: Returns the currently selected filter entry.

methods.name: updateConfiguredFilters
methods.description: Refreshes the filter list and GUI based on current filter entries.
